title: PolyDiff Proto-Family Fact Vector
description: Per-implementation fact vector for the proto family. Sibling of fact-vector.schema.json (URL family), fact-vector-image.schema.json (image family), fact-vector-opengraph.schema.json (opengraph family), fact-vector-deeplink.schema.json (deeplink family), and fact-vector-qr.schema.json (qr family); all share input_id + parser_profile as the cross-family identity keys that the diff engine pairs vectors on. Axes follow the T-M2.6 spec (9 axes): format_kind, declared_schema_version, message_type_name, field_count, field_unknown_count, oneof_active_field, decoded_field_summary, parser_warnings, decode_outcome. When a wrapper binary/package is absent (e.g. protoc, flatc, or msgpack toolchain is not installed in the devcontainer; gogo-protobuf is bundled as a stub) the wrapper emits a crash envelope with binary_missing=true and decode_outcome.status='parse_error'; that envelope still validates so the missing parser stays auditable in the diff report.

binary_missing.description: Set by the wrapper when the underlying parser binary/package is not available. The proto axes are then null and decode_outcome.status MUST be 'parse_error'.

format_kind.description: Wire-format family. Always reported by the wrapper so the diff engine can pair like-with-like in the multi-format common-payload anchors. binary_missing envelopes still set this to the format the wrapper would have decoded.

declared_schema_version.description: Schema-version field declared by the payload's well-known wrapper message (e.g. 'v2', 'v3' for protobuf editions; or null when the format doesn't carry a schema-version axis). Divergence here is cosmetic (LOW).

message_type_name.description: Fully-qualified message type name as resolved by the decoder (e.g. 'com.example.Message'). null when the wrapper cannot resolve the type (unknown / out-of-schema).

field_count.description: Number of fields the decoder recognized in the payload. Divergence indicates decoded-summary disagreement.

field_unknown_count.description: Number of fields present in the wire-format payload but unknown to the decoder's schema. gogo-protobuf vs google-protobuf typically disagree here on extra fields; divergence triggers the unknown-field-handling bug class (MEDIUM-HIGH).

oneof_active_field.description: Name of the active field in a 'oneof' group, if applicable. Divergence indicates oneof-ambiguity (MEDIUM-HIGH); two decoders pick different fields from the same wire bytes.

decoded_field_summary.description: Sparse summary of decoded field values (key = field name, value = decoded representation). Used for cross-impl decoded-value comparison. null for binary_missing / parse_error envelopes.

parser_warnings.description: Implementation-emitted warnings (e.g. 'unknown field tag', 'oversized field', 'oneof collision'). Empty array on a clean parse.

decode_outcome.description: Implementation-reported decode outcome. 'parse_error' covers wrapper crash / FileNotFoundError (binary missing) / parser exception; 'decode_error' is a clean rejection by the decoder (malformed wire bytes); 'schema_mismatch' is a recognized payload with a type the wrapper's schema doesn't know; 'ok' is a clean decode.
